title: Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation with Lévy noise in the Meyer--Zheng topology
summary: We study the Smoluchowski-Kramers approximation for a stochastic wave equation with state-dependent damping on a bounded domain, driven by both a $Q$-Wiener process and a Lévy process with finite second moment. As $\varepsilon\to0$, we prove that $u^\varepsilon$ converges in distribution, in the Meyer-Zheng topology, to the unique weak solution of an overdamped stochastic parabolic equation. The proof relies on a nonlinear transformation associated with the damping coefficient, uniform energy estimates, and compactness arguments in the pseudo-path topology.
